reason: I'm two waiters short, so anything that lets guests pay without waiting for someone to bring the terminal helps me right now. Three months free, my POS stays the same and the first paid month is free if it flops, so I'd sign up as a founding restaurant and see. I'm not committing past that yet.
objection: I don't believe most of my guests, especially the older regulars, will scan a QR to pay instead of handing over a card or cash. And if the Keepz fee is higher than my bank terminal, I lose money on every bill.
would_change_my_mind: If the written Keepz fee comes in above my terminal's rate, or setup takes more than the one visit and 30 minutes they promise, I'd drop it.
